summary: ChipMOS Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting unaudited May 2026 revenue of NT$2,384.3 million (US$76.0 million), a 17.7% YoY increase but a 3.1% MoM decrease. The release notes ongoing revenue strength from AI-related demand and capacity expansion. There is no mention of any transaction, strategic review, corporate action, or management change. This is a routine monthly revenue update by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a standard earnings or operational update under US reporting rules. No special situation is triggered; the filing is purely informational.
